content.heading: What Is Algorithmic Trading?
content.body:
Algorithmic trading means using computer programs to execute trading decisions automatically based on predefined rules. The rules can be simple (buy when the 50-day MA crosses above the 200-day MA) or extraordinarily complex (machine learning models processing alternative data). What they share: decisions are made by code, not by real-time human emotion.

Systematic vs Discretionary Trading

Discretionary trading is what most traders do — they analyse charts, read news, form a view, and place trades based on judgment. This can work, but it is subject to emotional biases, inconsistency, and the physical limits of human attention.

Systematic (algorithmic) trading defines rules in advance and follows them mechanically. It cannot panic, get overconfident, or deviate from the rules. The tradeoff is that it also cannot adapt dynamically to genuinely novel market conditions.

What Algorithms Do Well

  • Speed — Execution in microseconds, reacting to data faster than any human.
  • Consistency — Every signal generates the same response, every time, without hesitation.
  • Scale — Simultaneously monitoring hundreds of stocks, dozens of signals, and multiple timeframes.
  • Backtesting — Testing a strategy against years of historical data in seconds to understand its statistical properties.
  • Emotionlessness — No FOMO, no panic, no revenge trading. The system executes the plan.

The Phantom Traders API

The Phantom Traders API (Elite plan) provides programmatic access to your portfolio data, alerts system, screener, and historical analytics. This course will take you from zero to a working automated strategy: authenticated, connected, backtested, and running.

Prerequisite: Basic Python knowledge required — variables, loops, functions, and dictionaries. All API code is provided as working templates you can adapt to your own strategies.

quiz.q: The primary advantage of systematic trading over discretionary trading is:
opts: Consistent, emotion-free rule execution without hesitation or deviation
Eliminates the need to understand market fundamentals
